paragraphs.text: After his I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that no wind should blow on the earth, or on the sea, or upon any tree.
paragraphs.original: Μετὰ τοῦτο εἶδον τέσσαρας ἀγγέλους ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τὰς τέσσαρας γωνίας τῆς γῆς, κρατοῦντας τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀνέμους τῆς γῆς, ἵνα μὴ πνέῃ ἄνεμος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς μήτε ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης μήτε ἐπὶ πᾶν δένδρον.
paragraphs.translit: Meta touto eidon tessaras angelous hestōtas epi tas tessaras gōnias tēs gēs, kratountas tous tessaras anemous tēs gēs, hina mē pneē anemos epi tēs gēs mēte epi tēs thalassēs mēte epi pan dendron.

paragraphs.text: And I saw another angel ascend from the sunrising, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a great voice to the four angels to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον ἀναβαίνοντα ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου, ἔχοντα σφραγῖδα θεοῦ ζῶντος, καὶ ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ἀγγέλοις οἷς ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἀδικῆσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,
paragraphs.translit: kai eidon allon angelon anabainonta apo anatolēs hēliou, echonta sphragida theou zōntos, kai ekraxen phōnē megalē tois tessarsin angelois hois edothē autois adikēsai tēn gēn kai tēn thalassan,

paragraphs.text: saying, Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we shall have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.
paragraphs.original: λέγων· Μὴ ἀδικήσητε τὴν γῆν μήτε τὴν θάλασσαν μήτε τὰ δένδρα, ἄχρι σφραγίσωμεν τοὺς δούλους τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: legōn· Mē adikēsēte tēn gēn mēte tēn thalassan mēte ta dendra, achri sphragisōmen tous doulous tou theou hēmōn epi tōn metōpōn autōn.

paragraphs.text: And I heard the number of them that were sealed, a hundred and forty and four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἐσφραγισμένων, ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τέσσαρες χιλιάδες, ἐσφραγισμένοι ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ·
paragraphs.translit: Kai ēkousa ton arithmon tōn esphragismenōn, hekaton tesserakonta tessares chiliades, esphragismenoi ek pasēs phylēs hyiōn Israēl·

paragraphs.text: Of the tribe of Judah [were] sealed twelve thousand: Of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand;
paragraphs.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰούδα δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι, ἐκ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Γὰδ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,
paragraphs.translit: ek phylēs Iouda dōdeka chiliades esphragismenoi, ek phylēs Rhoubēn dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Gad dōdeka chiliades,

paragraphs.text: Of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand;
paragraphs.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Νεφθαλὶμ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,
paragraphs.translit: ek phylēs Asēr dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Nephthalim dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Manassē dōdeka chiliades,

paragraphs.text: Of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand;
paragraphs.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Συμεὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Λευὶ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰσσαχὰρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,
paragraphs.translit: ek phylēs Symeōn dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Leui dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Issachar dōdeka chiliades,

paragraphs.text: Of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand; Of the tribe of Benjamin [were] sealed twelve thousand.
paragraphs.original: ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰωσὴφ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμὶν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι.
paragraphs.translit: ek phylēs Zaboulōn dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Iōsēph dōdeka chiliades, ek phylēs Beniamin dōdeka chiliades esphragismenoi.

paragraphs.text: After these things I saw, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of [all] tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, arrayed in white robes, and palms in their hands;
paragraphs.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ὄχλος πολύς, ὃν ἀριθμῆσαι αὐτὸν οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο, ἐκ παντὸς ἔθνους καὶ φυλῶν καὶ λαῶν καὶ γλωσσῶν, ἑστῶτες ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρνίου, περιβεβλημένους στολὰς λευκάς, καὶ φοίνικες ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Meta tauta eidon, kai idou ochlos polys, hon arithmēsai auton oudeis edynato, ek pantos ethnous kai phylōn kai laōn kai glōssōn, hestōtes enōpion tou thronou kai enōpion tou arniou, peribeblēmenous stolas leukas, kai phoinikes en tais chersin autōn·

paragraphs.text: and they cry with a great voice, saying,     Salvation unto our God who sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb.
paragraphs.original: καὶ κράζουσι φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες· Ἡ σωτηρία τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ καὶ τῷ ἀρνίῳ.
paragraphs.translit: kai krazousi phōnē megalē legontes· Hē sōtēria tō theō hēmōn tō kathēmenō epi tō thronō kai tō arniō.

paragraphs.text: And all the angels were standing round about the throne, and [about] the elders and the four living creatures; and they fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped God,
paragraphs.original: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι εἱστήκεισαν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων, καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ἐπὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ θεῷ,
paragraphs.translit: kai pantes hoi angeloi heistēkeisan kyklō tou thronou kai tōn presbyterōn kai tōn tessarōn zōōn, kai epesan enōpion tou thronou epi ta prosōpa autōn kai prosekynēsan tō theō,

paragraphs.text: saying,     Amen: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honor, and power, and might, [be] unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: λέγοντες· Ἀμήν· ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ ἡ σοφία καὶ ἡ εὐχαριστία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δύναμις καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: legontes· Amēn· hē eulogia kai hē doxa kai hē sophia kai hē eucharistia kai hē timē kai hē dynamis kai hē ischys tō theō hēmōn eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn· amēn.

paragraphs.text: And one of the elders answered, saying unto me, These that are arrayed in white robes, who are they, and whence came they?
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἀπεκρίθη εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγων μοι· Οὗτοι οἱ περιβεβλημένοι τὰς στολὰς τὰς λευκὰς τίνες εἰσὶν καὶ πόθεν ἦλθον;
paragraphs.translit: Kai apekrithē heis ek tōn presbyterōn legōn moi· Houtoi hoi peribeblēmenoi tas stolas tas leukas tines eisin kai pothen ēlthon;

paragraphs.text: And I say unto him, My lord, thou knowest. And he said to me, These are they that come of the great tribulation, and they washed their robes, and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἴρηκα αὐτῷ· Κύριέ μου, σὺ οἶδας. καὶ εἶπέν μοι· Οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐρχόμενοι ἐκ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς μεγάλης, καὶ ἔπλυναν τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλεύκαναν αὐτὰς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ ἀρνίου.
paragraphs.translit: kai eirēka autō· Kyrie mou, sy oidas. kai eipen moi· Houtoi eisin hoi erchomenoi ek tēs thlipseōs tēs megalēs, kai eplynan tas stolas autōn kai eleukanan autas en tō haimati tou arniou.

paragraphs.text: Therefore are they before the throne of God; and they serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall spread his tabernacle over them.
paragraphs.original: διὰ τοῦτό εἰσιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ λατρεύουσιν αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου σκηνώσει ἐπʼ αὐτούς.
paragraphs.translit: dia touto eisin enōpion tou thronou tou theou, kai latreuousin autō hēmeras kai nyktos en tō naō autou, kai ho kathēmenos epi tou thronou skēnōsei epʼ autous.

paragraphs.text: They shall hunger no more, neither thirst any more; neither shall the sun strike upon them, nor any heat:
paragraphs.original: οὐ πεινάσουσιν ἔτι οὐδὲ διψήσουσιν ἔτι, οὐδὲ μὴ πέσῃ ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ὁ ἥλιος οὐδὲ πᾶν καῦμα,
paragraphs.translit: ou peinasousin eti oude dipsēsousin eti, oude mē pesē epʼ autous ho hēlios oude pan kauma,

paragraphs.text: for the Lamb that is in the midst of the throne shall be their shepherd, and shall guide them unto fountains of waters of life: and God shall wipe away every tear from their eyes.
paragraphs.original: ὅτι τὸ ἀρνίον τὸ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θρόνου ποιμανεῖ αὐτούς, καὶ ὁδηγήσει αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ ζωῆς πηγὰς ὑδάτων· καὶ ἐξαλείψει ὁ θεὸς πᾶν δάκρυον ἐκ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: hoti to arnion to ana meson tou thronou poimanei autous, kai hodēgēsei autous epi zōēs pēgas hydatōn· kai exaleipsei ho theos pan dakryon ek tōn ophthalmōn autōn.
